Data on railway bridges
*81. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA RAO:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether CAG has warned that the
absence of data on construction of over one
lakh railway bridges may hamper their
monitoring; and
(b) if so, the remedial measures
proposed to be taken in this regard?
Cotton production
*82. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the production of cotton
which was 14 million bales before, has
come down to less than 9 million bales;
(b) whether the cotton growers are in
trouble in spite of Bt-cotton being grown
in a substantial area; and
(c) if so, the steps Government propose
to take to improve the condition of cotton
growers?
Digital weather broadcast services
*83. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO: Will the Minister of SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Meteorological Department has started
satellite based digital weather broadcast
services to help the fishermen and
seafarers;
(b) if so, the details of the digital
technology that is being used to help the
fishermen;
(c) whether this service can be used by
other agencies; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Rail projects in Rajasthan
†*84. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of on-going new rail
projects and surveys conducted in
Rajasthan alongwith the progress made for
the completion of these projects so far;
(b) the project-wise details of funds
allocated and expenditure incurred on these
projects;

Review of working of Bharat Shiksha
Kosh
*85. SHRI R.P. GOENKA:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set up a
Bharat Shiksha Kosh to make it a sole
authority to receive and disburse funds
donated by alumnus to their alma mater in
India;
(b) whether Government have reviewed
the working of the Bharat Shiksha Kosh;
(c) if so, the result thereof;
(d) whether it is also a fact that due to
such interception by Government in the
flow of funds to IITs and IIMs, the wishes
of the donors are not honoured and the
donors are becoming hesitant to further
donate; and
(e) if so, the steps taken to allay the fears
of the donors, especially the N.R.I's and
also to clarify the role of Government in
utilising these contributions?
Centrally sponsored environment
projects in Assam
*86. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of Centrally sponsored
environment projects launched in the State
of Assam during the last three years;
(b) the total amount provided by
Government for this purpose during this
period;
(c) the details of the achievements made
in this regard; and
(d) the details of such projects proposed
to be launched in the State during the Tenth
Plan?
Suicide by farmers in Andhra Pradesh
*87. DR. DASARI NARAYANA RAO:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) number of farmers who committed
suicide due to crop loss or indebted-
ness in Andhra Pradesh during the last
three years, year-wise and district-wise;
and
(b) what steps Government have taken
or propose to take to ensure that hapless
farmers do not resort to this extreme step
in the State and rest of the country?
Platforms at Madurai railway
station
*88. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Madurai railway station has
a heavy traffic but there are not enough
platforms;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government propose to
increase the number of platforms there;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

Subsidy to fertilizer manufacturers
†*89. SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have adopted different methods for
providing subsidy to different kinds of
chemical fertilizer manufacturers of the
country;
(b) if so, method-wise details of
chemical fertilizer manufacturers who are
provided with subsidy; and
(c) details of the benefit of adopting
these methods?

Investment in agriculture
562. SHRI SURESH PACHOURI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the investment in agriculture as a
percentage of GDP during the Seventh,
Eighth and Ninth Five Year Plans;
(b) the target set for the Tenth Five Year
Plan;
(c) whether investment as percentage of
GDP is very low considering the
contribution of agriculture to GDP; and
(d) if so, the steps being taken to increase
investment in agriculture?
Suicide by farmers in Punjab
563. DR. AKHILESH DAS:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had received
reports that more than sixty farmers had
committed suicides in Punjab during
2002-2003;
(b) whether reports of suicides by
farmers under pressure loan recovery by
banks and financial institutions during that
year were also  received from other States,
if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether such recovery continued
even in drought hit areas despite Prime
Minister's announcement for its non-
recovery; and
(d) the steps taken by Government, the
Reserve Bank of India and other authorities
to relieve the stress of debt recovery from
farmers' mind?
Central assistance to drought hit
States
564. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI :
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether high level task force on
drought has considered demands of drought
hit States for additional Central assistance;
(b) whether Centre has convened a
meeting to prepare contingency plans to deal
with any drought like situation in the current
fiscal;
(c) whether Andhra Pradesh
Government and other drought hit States
have fully utilised the amount, so far,
provided to them to meet drought;

Centre to double States quota of foodgrains

Implementing Agriculture Policy
565. DR. M.N. DAS:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have called
greater efforts in implementing Indian
Agriculture Policy;
(b) if so, whether due to the starvation
deaths at a time when there was overflowing
granaries of foodgrains in the country,
Government have decided to examine option
of drastically changing policy of stocking
foodgrains;
(c) whether the main aim and objective
of the agricultural research and development
was how to prepare a road map of the policy
strategies and to meet resources available to
implement the policy; and
(d) if so, what are the changes that are
being made to make Agriculture Policy
suitable to India?
Flood and drought in States
566. SHRI SURENDRA LATH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) the States which are affected by recent
flood and drought in this year;
(b) the extent of damage caused to those
States due to these natural calamities; and
(c) the details of steps taken to extend
adequate Central assistance to undertake
relief and rehabilitation measures?
Crop diversification
567.SHRI NANA DESHMUKH: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether crop diversification has been
recognised as a device to reduce drought
impact;
(b) if so, what steps have been taken by
Government to propagate the device; and
(c) what concrete steps have been taken
by the Centre in collaboration with State
Governments for effective implementation
of soil and water conservation measures
through watershed development in rain-fed
areas?
Computer purchase scam in ICAR
†568. SHRI BALKAVI BAIRAGI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that instead of
penalising the persons accused of computer
purchase scam involving crores of rupees
in ICAR, Government are trying to hush up
the matter;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the Central
Vigilance Commission despite their all out
efforts have not so far recovered the reports
of the Pawan Raina Committee and the
Bhaskar Barua Committee which have
conducted departmental enquiry; and
(c) if the position contained in (a) and
(b) above are correct, what action
Government have taken in this regard and
the details thereof?
